sources.t: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
sources.f: Published 13 May 2026; reports fixed and mobile availability using data as of January 2026 and describes methodology limits.
sources.g: A national snapshot and modelled mobile predictions are not a live exact-address orderability check.

sources.t: Connected Nations - Planned Network Deployments 2026
sources.f: Published 13 May 2026; examines anticipated full-fibre, gigabit-capable and high-speed fixed-wireless expansion through the end of 2028.
sources.g: Forward-looking operator plans do not establish present network completion or retail service at a parcel.

sources.t: The Communications Market 2026
sources.f: Published in 2026; the official interactive portal presents communications-industry and consumer-research indicators.
sources.g: Market-level metrics and third-party headline figures are not exact premises connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Communications Market Report 2026 interactive data
sources.f: Published 30 June 2026; interactive data covers take-up and use of internet connectivity and related consumer research.
sources.g: Interactive national survey data cannot prove a provider can serve a specific address.

sources.t: Latest telecoms and pay-TV complaints revealed - Q4 2025
sources.f: Published 11 May 2026; reports complaint rates for major broadband, landline, mobile and pay-TV providers for Q4 2025.
sources.g: Provider complaint rates measure customer dissatisfaction and do not establish network availability at a parcel.

sources.t: Broadband complaints fall to record low
sources.f: Published 23 July 2026; reports Q1 2026 complaint trends and an all-time low for broadband complaints received by Ofcom.
sources.g: Complaint-rate improvement is service-quality context, not current address-level coverage evidence.

sources.t: Report: Complaints about broadband, landline, mobile and pay-TV services
sources.f: Updated 23 July 2026; publishes quarterly complaints received about major communications providers.
sources.g: Aggregated complaint statistics cannot confirm exact-premises serviceability.

sources.t: Investigation into BT compliance with statutory information requests
sources.f: Published 29 April 2026; records an Ofcom investigation concerning information supplied for regulatory service-quality work.
sources.g: An enforcement investigation does not prove provider network reach or orderability at an address.

sources.t: Choosing the best mobile, broadband and landline provider
sources.f: Updated 10 February 2026; provides service-quality comparison guidance based on customer and provider information.
sources.g: Provider comparison material requires a separate availability check for any specific premises.

sources.t: One Touch Switch enforcement programme
sources.f: Closed 11 June 2026; records Ofcom's programme concerning industry's delayed implementation of One Touch Switch rules.
sources.g: Switching compliance concerns process obligations and does not establish underlying network availability.

sources.t: Switching broadband provider
sources.f: Updated 1 July 2026; explains One Touch Switch, contract charges and the address details needed to move broadband provider.
sources.g: Switching guidance presupposes selectable services and does not prove that every provider serves the address.

sources.t: Your right to request a decent broadband service
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; explains eligibility to request a decent affordable broadband connection under the universal service obligation.
sources.g: A legal right to request an upgrade is not evidence of an already active or orderable gigabit connection.

sources.t: Practical tips for improving broadband speed
sources.f: Official guidance explains broadband speed estimates, codes of practice, fault factors and the broadband universal service obligation.
sources.g: In-home troubleshooting and estimated-speed guidance do not establish parcel-level network reach.

sources.t: Simpler and quicker broadband switching is here
sources.f: Published 12 September 2024; explains the launch and operation of One Touch Switch across fixed networks.
sources.g: A switching process and increased market choice do not prove exact-address availability.

sources.t: Closure of the May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review
sources.f: Updated 1 June 2026; records closure of the May 2026 national supplier coverage and planned-build data collection.
sources.g: Supplier submissions combine current and planned infrastructure and are not a live retail order check.

sources.t: Project Gigabit supporting document templates
sources.f: Updated 24 April 2026; provides consultation, logic-table, licensing and privacy materials used in Project Gigabit reviews.
sources.g: Templates and classification logic are process evidence, not current premises connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit contracts collection
sources.f: Official collection indexes awarded regional contracts and the Openreach framework for hard-to-reach premises.
sources.g: A contract index is discovery evidence and cannot prove that an individual connection is complete or orderable.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Public Reviews collection
sources.f: Official collection indexes regional Public Reviews and consultation outcomes across the UK.
sources.g: Historic intervention mapping and consultation outcomes require fresh UPRN and provider validation.

sources.t: Kent Public Review closure notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; records closure material and later contract-redesign context for Kent.
sources.g: Public-review classification and redesigned contract scope do not confirm present service at a premises.

sources.t: Suffolk Lot 2 Public Review closure notice
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; records the Suffolk Lot 2 Public Review closure and outcome materials.
sources.g: Closed public-review evidence is historic procurement context, not exact current orderability.
